# v1.1.0-dev.81 — The title bar wears the icon

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.80`.

A one-line follow-on to dev.80, which is the release that gave WLM an
icon in the first place.

## The Pink Square Is The App Mark Now

dev.80 put a real icon on the taskbar and left the window showing
something else. The little pink `▦` up in the title bar was a text
glyph, chosen back when there was no icon to match it to. So the thing
you saw in the taskbar and the thing you saw in the window were two
different logos.

The title bar draws the actual mark now: one tall cyan pane beside two
stacked greys, the same shape sitting on your taskbar. It's an inline
vector rather than an image file, which lets it take its colours from
the same stylesheet variables as everything else around it and stay
crisp at any display scaling.

Being honest about the edges: dialog title bars, the empty-state panel
and the About tab still draw the old glyph. Those are cyan rather than
pink and read fine on their own. They are a separate decision rather
than an oversight.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
